js: (()=>{const d=window.__dbg;const g=d.scene.getObjectByName('bedShadow');const fp=g.userData.footprint;const m=g.children.find(o=>o.isInstancedMesh);if(!m)return 'no ring';const M=new d.THREE.Matrix4(),P=new d.THREE.Vector3(),Q=new d.THREE.Quaternion(),S=new d.THREE.Vector3();let hMin=1e9,hMax=0,hSum=0,dMax=0,dMin=1e9,wSum=0;for(let i=0;i<m.count;i++){m.getMatrixAt(i,M);M.decompose(P,Q,S);const h=0.62*S.y;hMin=Math.min(hMin,h);hMax=Math.max(hMax,h);hSum+=h;wSum+=0.075*S.x;const qx=Math.abs(P.x-fp.cx)-fp.hx,qz=Math.abs(P.z-fp.cz)-fp.hz;const dd=Math.hypot(Math.max(qx,0),Math.max(qz,0))+Math.min(Math.max(qx,qz),0);dMax=Math.max(dMax,dd);dMin=Math.min(dMin,dd);}return {ringCount:m.count,bladeH_avg:+(hSum/m.count).toFixed(3),bladeH_min:+hMin.toFixed(3),bladeH_max:+hMax.toFixed(3),bladeW_avg:+(wSum/m.count).toFixed(3),distFromBedEdge_min:+dMin.toFixed(3),distFromBedEdge_max:+dMax.toFixed(3),normalGrassH:'0.62*[0.75..1.45]*[0.8..1.4] => 0.37~1.26'};})()
